about.text:
Sample: Dana Okonkwo, admin of Harbor Community Kitchen. A v1 NGO has one account, the admin; members come after the pilot.

The sign-up flow (Sign-up and sign-in canvas) creates the account and the organisation with its name. Board 1 and board 4 start right after it: finish the profile (mission, country, website, logo), then land on Your projects with no project yet.

Boards 2 and 5: a returning admin with four projects, one at each pilot stage: a private draft, a Discovery chat in progress, a finished brief, and a project Discovery declined.

The intake form, the Discovery chat and the brief are on their own canvases; here those buttons open a placeholder.
